RESIDENTIAL LEASE

HAWTHORNE RENTALS, INC., a Florida corporation ("Landlord"), and ALEX RIVERA and JAMIE CHEN (together, "Tenant"), agree as follows. Each person signing as Tenant is responsible for the whole rent and for every promise in this Lease.

1. PREMISES.

Landlord rents to Tenant the duplex unit known as 3315 SE 21st Place, Unit B, Gainesville, Florida 32641 (the "Premises"), including the refrigerator, range, dishwasher, and the washer and dryer hookups. The yard is shared with Unit A.

2. TERM.

The term of this Lease begins on August 1, 2026 and ends on July 31, 2027.

3. RENT.

Tenant shall pay rent of $1,100.00 per month, in advance, on or before the first day of each month, without demand. Rent shall be paid at Landlord's office or by mail to the address in Paragraph 20, by check or money order payable to Hawthorne Rentals, Inc. Landlord may require certified funds after any returned check.

4. LATE CHARGES AND RETURNED CHECKS.

If any rent is not received by Landlord by 5:00 p.m. on the third (3rd) day of the month, Tenant shall pay a late charge of $55.00. If rent and the late charge are not paid in full by the tenth (10th) day of the month, Tenant shall pay an additional late charge of $5.00 for each day after the tenth until paid. Tenant shall pay $35.00 for each check returned unpaid by the bank. Late charges and returned check charges are additional rent.

5. SECURITY DEPOSIT.

Tenant has paid Landlord a security deposit of $1,100.00 to secure Tenant's performance of this Lease. Landlord will hold the deposit in a separate interest-bearing account at Merchants and Southern Bank, Gainesville, Florida, and Tenant will receive interest at the rate required by Florida law. The deposit may not be used by Tenant to pay the last month's rent.

6. USE AND OCCUPANCY.

The Premises shall be used only as a private residence for the persons named as Tenant. No other person may live at the Premises without Landlord's written consent. A guest may not stay more than fourteen (14) days in any six-month period without Landlord's written consent.

7. UTILITIES.

Tenant shall pay for electricity, water, sewer, and internet service, and shall have those services placed in Tenant's name with Gainesville Regional Utilities before the term begins. Landlord shall pay for garbage collection.

8. PETS.

Tenant may keep one (1) cat at the Premises. No dogs or other animals are allowed without Landlord's written consent. Tenant has paid a refundable pet deposit of $200.00, which Landlord will hold with the security deposit, and Tenant shall pay for any damage caused by the cat, including flea treatment at move-out.

9. MAINTENANCE BY LANDLORD.

Landlord shall keep the roof, windows, screens, doors, floors, steps, exterior walls, foundation, and plumbing in good repair, and shall maintain the heating and air-conditioning system, the water heater, and the appliances furnished by Landlord, except for damage caused by Tenant, Tenant's guests, or Tenant's pet.

10. REPAIR REQUESTS.

Tenant shall report the need for any repair by calling Landlord's office at (352) 555-0123, Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. For a repair that cannot wait, such as a water leak, a sewer backup, or a loss of air conditioning, Tenant shall call Landlord's after-hours maintenance line at (352) 555-0177. Tenant shall not hire anyone to make a repair at Landlord's expense without Landlord's written approval.

11. MAINTENANCE BY TENANT.

Tenant shall keep the Premises clean and sanitary, remove garbage, keep the plumbing fixtures clean, use all appliances and systems in a reasonable manner, change the air-conditioning filter every month, replace smoke detector batteries, and mow and edge the front and side yard of Unit B at least twice a month from April through October.

12. ALTERATIONS.

Tenant shall not paint, install shelving, change or add locks, or make any other alteration to the Premises without Landlord's written consent.

13. ACCESS BY LANDLORD.

Landlord may enter the Premises at reasonable times to inspect, make repairs, or show the Premises to buyers, tenants, or contractors. Except in an emergency, Landlord will give Tenant at least twelve (12) hours' notice and will enter only between 8:00 a.m. and 7:00 p.m.

14. ASSIGNMENT AND SUBLETTING.

Tenant shall not sublet the Premises or any part of it, or assign this Lease, without Landlord's written consent.

15. RENTER'S INSURANCE.

Landlord's insurance does not cover Tenant's belongings. Tenant is encouraged, but not required, to carry renter's insurance.

16. PARKING.
Tenant may park two (2) vehicles on the paved driveway of Unit B. No vehicle may be parked on the lawn, and no boat, trailer, or inoperable vehicle may be kept at the Premises.
17. NOISE AND CONDUCT.
Tenant, Tenant's guests, and anyone else at the Premises with Tenant's permission shall not disturb the occupants of Unit A or the neighbors. No party of more than twenty (20) people may be held at the Premises.
18. EARLY TERMINATION.
If Tenant wishes to end this Lease before the end of the term, Tenant may do so by giving Landlord at least sixty (60) days' written notice and paying an early termination fee equal to two months' rent ($2,200.00) by the date Tenant moves out, in which case Tenant owes no rent for any period after Tenant moves out and returns the keys. If Tenant moves out early without doing both, Tenant remains liable for rent through the end of the term, less any rent Landlord receives from a new tenant.
19. END OF TERM.
Either party may end the tenancy at the end of the term by giving the other written notice at least thirty (30) days before July 31, 2027. If neither party gives notice, the tenancy will continue month to month on the same terms, and either party may end it by giving at least fifteen (15) days' written notice before the end of a monthly period.
20. NOTICES.
All notices to Landlord must be in writing and delivered by hand to Landlord's office, or sent by certified mail, to Hawthorne Rentals, Inc., 1702 NW 13th Street, Suite 4, Gainesville, Florida 32609. Mail may also be sent to P.O. Box 14077, Gainesville, Florida 32604. Notices to Tenant may be delivered to the Premises.
21. MOLD.
Tenant shall keep the Premises well ventilated, run the air conditioning or fans to keep humidity down, and report any mold or water leak to Landlord within two (2) days of noticing it.
22. ABANDONMENT.
If Tenant is absent from the Premises for fifteen (15) days or more without paying rent and without telling Landlord, Landlord may treat the Premises as abandoned as Florida law allows.
23. ENTIRE AGREEMENT.
This Lease is the entire agreement between Landlord and Tenant. It may be changed only in a writing signed by Landlord and every Tenant.
LANDLORD: HAWTHORNE RENTALS, INC.
